messages:
maya.chen: quick FYI — after the int4 quant pass on q4b-multilang we started seeing a ~4.2% uptick in deid false positives for short prompts (<32 tok). noticed across arabic, devanagari, and some cjk samples :thinking_face:
arjun.patel: i compared token id distributions; looks like token boundaries changed for several scripts after the int4 tokenmap recompute. short examples split differently now. link to plot: https://s3.redwood-inference/q4b/int4/token_shift.png
sam.k: are we certain this is tokenization and not a downstream comparator change? did the dedupe pipeline inadvertently stop running nfkc before fingerprinting?
maya.chen: checked pipeline diff — int4 CI used tokenizer v2 without nfkc+casefold. older baseline used nfkc normalize + fold before token ids.
priya.rao: can you provide smallest repro pairs so label ops can triage?
arjun.patel: example (short):
```
input: "تجربة"  # arabic short word
fp32 tokens: [1123, 4521]
int4 tokens: [1123, 97, 4521]
```
split added a tiny token -> fingerprint drift -> dedupe mismatch.
sam.k: that explains sampler routing differences; labeler pipeline hashes token_ids so new split changes dedupe decisions.
maya.chen: proposed plan:
1) run a targeted re-fingerprint of flagged candidates using nfkc+casefold (only candidate set, not gold)
2) assemble a 200-sample micro-audit across scripts for linguist review + ML check
3) pause golden_v3 rollouts until audit completes
arjun.patel: created s3 manifest: s3://redwood-ci/q4b/int4/tokenmap_flagged/fails.csv. re-fingerprint cmd: `scripts/tools/refingerprint.py --norm nfkc --casefold --tokenizer v2 --input s3://.../fails.csv --output s3://.../refingered.csv`
```bash
python3 scripts/tools/refingerprint.py \
  --norm nfkc --casefold \
  --tokenizer v2 \
  --input s3://redwood-ci/q4b/int4/fails.csv \
  --output s3://redwood-ci/q4b/int4/refingered.csv
```
priya.rao: will create label job scoped to "multilang-tokenmap-audit". prefer native linguists first pass, then ML review. estimated 48h.
label-ops-bot: Created label job 5237 for owner priya.rao — 2000 samples, tag: multilang-tokenmap-audit. ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:
sam.k: i'll run a baseline-vs-candidate diff on the 200-sample micro-audit and attach JSON diffs to the label job. command: `evals/compare_outputs.py --baseline s3://baselines/fp32/ --candidate s3://int4/q4b/ --ids s3://.../micro_ids.csv`
arjun.patel: also spun up canary set canary/int4-tokenmap-check/200. if label FP > 2% we auto-rollback int4 for multilang.
maya.chen: action owners: arjun -> refingerprint + micro set (done), priya -> label job owner + triage, sam -> run diffs and surface hallucination/regressions. add pre-fingerprint nfkc+casefold to int4 CI as opt-in canary.
priya.rao: ack. i'll watch for worker allocation conflicts with translations team.
label-ops-bot: Label job 5237 status: queued. worker allocation ETA ~2h.
arjun.patel: follow-up Q: should we permanently add nfkc normalization pre-tokenize for non-en languages in quant pipeline? seems low risk and prevents future drift.
sam.k: +1 for canary opt-in then roll to default after audit passes. keep logs and diffs stored.
maya.chen: agreed. hold golden_v3 until we clear the audit. ping if any blockers. :pray:
